mentions.name: Merrilin
mentions.description: An ebook reading app built to deliver the best possible reading experience, released on Android with an iOS release coming soon. It grew out of a years-long list of desired reading app features.
mentions.problem: The Kindle and every other reading app gave a sub-par reading experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: We started building https://merrilin.ai in February this year, and it's been going good. We released on Android, and we're also releasing on iOS soon. It's a passion project of ours, we wanted to build the best damned ebook reading app there is, and it bloomed from there. I was tired of the Kindle and every other reading app giving me a sub-par reading experience.
mentions.author: stonecharioteer

mentions.name: Merrilin
mentions.description: An ebook reader that lets users read books anywhere and ask questions about their content, with AI-powered question answering, currently open to public access.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The best damned ebook reader you'll ever use. Ready anywhere, ask anything.

We have been building https://merrilin.ai for 6 months now. Open to public access right now.
